therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation and survival pathways
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with relapsed, indolent or aggressive non-Hodgkin's lymphomas

results.effect_size: Part A Indolent NHL/CLL: 43.75% (95% CI: 28.73-59.68), Part A Aggressive NHL: 27.08% (95% CI: 16.83-39.57), Part B Indolent NHL: 59.15% (95% CI: 50.60-67.32)
subgroup_findings: Higher response rates in indolent NHL compared to aggressive NHL
Part B (60mg fixed dose) showed higher response rate than Part A (0.8mg/kg) in indolent NHL
results.dose_information: Part A: 0.8 mg/kg (max 65 mg) IV weekly for 3 weeks of 28-day cycle; Part B: 60 mg IV weekly for 3 weeks of 28-day cycle

context.duration: 16 weeks treatment with follow-up up to approximately 6-9 years
